calls.title: Growthbook // GES Weekly Check-In
calls.summary: The team devised a comprehensive outreach plan incorporating a structured schedule for event invites, emphasizing coordinated messaging through various channels like SDR emails and LinkedIn. Visual branding efforts are underway, with Liz overseeing signage details and Ashley confirming the order for printed materials. They created a prioritized shortlist of events focusing on audience relevance and sponsorship potential, particularly for AI-related opportunities. Additionally, team availability was discussed to mitigate conflicts during scheduled events, while budgeting discussions are ongoing to determine financial commitments for different sponsorship levels.
calls.keywords: Event Marketing, Sponsorship Planning, Product Events, Booth Setup, Event Budgeting, ICP Targeting
